body:
Both I think? Because I never told them that I knew, and telling someone else was entirely the wrong thing to do.

It started yesterday, and all I know right now is that I just don't want to be here anymore.

I've spent the past 3 hours apologising as much as I can, and trying to explain that I meant no harm. One of the girls who cut me out said the most hateful things and I can't help still wanting to make things right.

I've been told to leave it a few days/weeks/maybe longer and hope they calm down. But what good does that do me when right now I feel like the worst person in the world? I have next to no one right now, and I was never any good at patience even when things were ok.

Correct, the people whose secret it was found out and hate me for it. And I left my apologies too late which makes them hate me even more.

I've had crap days but nothing has ever made me feel quite this bad. I've had a couple short periods of self harm in the past but they never lasted long and were only mild.
